task: Owner-approved portal permission widening (get on one CustomResourceDefinition) and enabling the upstream latest-version lookup for Settings > OSS Updates

events.summary: Two changes the owner approved in chat on 2026-11-24 and nothing else: the portal ClusterRole gains get on the single CRD gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io (no list or watch, no other CRD), and OSS_UPDATES_UPSTREAM is rendered true except for provider kakao (air-gapped, no egress to api.github.com).

With portal 1.1.24 the OSS Updates page showed 24 rows: 22 in-sync, 1 not-applicable and 1 unknown. The unknown row was Gateway API CRDs with reason no-permission, and the upstream lookup reported disabled.
evidence: test:live measurement as system:serviceaccount:devtools:narwhal-portal through kubectl proxy (2026-11-23) -> drift counts in-sync 22, unknown 1 (Gateway API CRDs: no-permission), not-applicable 1; upstreamLookup disabled

events.summary: Added the resourceNames-scoped get rule to ClusterRole narwhal-portal and updated the pinned RBAC expectations so any other widening (list, watch, dropped resourceNames, another CRD) is still rejected. Added the OSS_UPDATES_UPSTREAM env with a provider switch (decision D-OSS-UPSTREAM recorded next to it: unauthenticated GitHub API limit 60 requests per hour per source IP, successful lookups cached 6 hours, failures cached 10 minutes and shown as unavailable; escape hatch is unsetting the env).

events.scope: Static checks, chart rendering and portal unit tests on the author's host; nothing applied to a cluster.
events.summary: RBAC pin checks reject other widenings, both provider branches render the expected env value, and the OSS update unit tests pass.
evidence: test:helm template narwhal-platform with provider vagrant and provider kakao -> OSS_UPDATES_UPSTREAM true and false respectively
test:cd portal && pnpm exec vitest run src/lib/oss-updates -> 5 files, 53 tests passed
test:make lint -> shellcheck passed; yamllint exited non-zero on pre-existing line-length errors in untouched files
